subject: words
title: Ch says k, ph says f
about: Two spellings from further along the code: ch can say k (school, echo, ache), so like oo and ow it is a try-it-both-ways spelling, and ph says f (phone, dolphin, elephant). Neither is in the CKLA Grade 1 code (both come in Grade 2 and 3), so this is a step-ahead level for the end of the year once the Sh and ch and Kn, wh and nk levels are solid; NC RF.1.4.a (consonant digraphs) and RF.1.4.b (decoding).
tip: If a ch word sounds wrong, say: try it the other way, with a k; ph is always f, so have him tap it as one dot and say f.
